exceptions.reason: False positive in mobsfscan 0.4.5: these two key arguments identify LazyColumn group headers and spacers using a UI prefix and the duplicate group ID. They are Compose item identities, not credentials or cryptographic keys. Match only the reviewed header and gap expressions; other hardcoded-value findings remain blocking.

False positive in mobsfscan 0.4.5: TOOL_KEY and VOLUME_KEY name WorkManager input Data fields populated by ScanScheduler.startTool and read by ToolScanWorker.doWork. The literal field names tool and volume are not credentials or cryptographic keys. Match only these reviewed literals in this worker; other hardcoded-value findings remain blocking.

False positive in mobsfscan 0.4.5: the month key identifies a LazyColumn screenshot month heading using a UI prefix and its month label. It is a Compose item identity, not a credential or cryptographic key. Match only this reviewed month expression; other hardcoded-value findings remain blocking.

False positive in mobsfscan 0.4.5: its source-manifest parser defaults an absent target SDK to 26 instead of reading Gradle. Gradle and the merged debug/release manifests specify minSdk 30 and targetSdk 37. Android 11 and newer include the StrandHogg platform fixes. Preserve the existing singleTop notification navigation.
